chapter.verse: Pasian’ min leh a thuhilhna in gensiatna a thuak loh nadingin, hakkol nuai-ah a omte in a tote uh a zahtak mahmah nading uh kilawm hi ci-in ciamteh uh hen.

A tote in thu-um mi ahih uh leh, unau khat ahih uh ciangin nasim lo, thudon loin, om kei uh hen. A nasepna-ah noptuamna a ngah mite in, a um mite leh it tuak mite ahih uh ciangin a nasep pha takin seem zaw ta uh hen. Hih thute hilh in la, hansuah in.
Thuhilhna tuam hilhin, i Topa Zeisu Khazih’ kam ahi, kam siangtho ahi zongin, Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna tawh a kilawm thuhilhna ahi zongin, a mang lo mi khatpeuh a om leh,

tua mi in kisathei-in, bangmah thei loin thu kidotna kikumin, a kam bek tawh a seel mihai ahi hi. Tua bang a bawl leh, en’na, kitotna, gensiatna, hazatna tawh upkhialhna lungsim neihna in thuman thu tawh a kipelh mite kitotnate a piang thei hi.
Tuate in Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna in sum hauhna hong piangsak hi ci-in a um uh hi.
Lungkimin Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna in hauhna lianpi a piangsak thei hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, eite in leitungah bangmah pua loin i tung a, bangmah pua loin i paikhia ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin neek ding, puansilh ding a om zah tawh lungkimin i om ding hi.

Sum a hau nuam mite in kheemna sungah, thang awkna sungah, hai-a noptuamna a siasak thei, deihgawhna atuam atuamte sungah a kia thei uh hi. Tua bang deihgawhna in mite kisiatna sungah a tum mangsak thei hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, sum hauh nopna in khialhna pawl khempeuh bul ahi hi. Mi kimkhat in sum hauh nopna hangin upna lampi pan paikhia-in, lunggimna apawlpawl tawh amau pumpi uh a vut let zo uh hi.
Pasian’ mi aw, nang na hih leh, tua mawhnate pel in la, dikna, Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna, upna, itna, thuakzawhna, lungnemnate na phak matengin na delh in.
Upna thu tawh kipawl galdona a pha na do in. Nuntak tawntungna na len in. Tua nuntakna ngah dingin nang in hong sapna na ngah a, teci tampite maiah na pang ngei hi.

Topa Zeisu Khazih hong kilat dongin nang in a nin baang loin mawhsak nading om loin, thupiakna na zuih nadingin na khempeuh a nungta sak Pasian mai-ah ahi zongin Pontias Pilat maiah pha takpi-a thuman teci a pang Khazih Zeisu mai-ah ahi zongin, keimah in nangma tungah thu kong pia hi.

Sihna tawh kipelh mi khat bek ahi, kuamah in a naih theiloh khuavak sungah om a, kuamah in a muh ngei loh, a muh theih loh, thupha a ngah Topa khat bek ahi kumpite’ Kumpipa, topate’ Topa in ama ciamtehna hun hong tun’ ciangin tua Topa’ hong kilat khiatna hong lak ding hi. Tua Pasian in pahtawina, vangliatna ngah tawntung ta hen. Amen.

Hih leitungah sum hau mite in lungsim kiliatsakna tawh kipelhin, a kip tawntung thei lo sum hauhna muang loin, eite lungdam nading na khempeuh a kicingin hong pia Pasian muangin, nuntakna taktak ahi nuntakna ngah nadingin, hong tung ding hun ciangin, amau ading a bulpi pha zong kholin, midangte tungah thupha bawlna, gamtat hoihna kicingin, midang hopnopna lungsim nei-in, khat leh khat kipawl nadingin kilemna thu bawl nading thu na pia in.
Timoti aw, nang hong kipia na, a pha takpi-in kem in. Nate’ thu pilna hi ci a, kiphuak khial, pilna thu tawh kipawl hi lo a, mawkna kamte, nate’ pilna khamna kinialnate na pel in.
Tua nate’ pilna, mi kimkhat in a mang uh a, a bawl manun upna lam pan a pial zo uh hi. Nangma tungah hehpihna thupha om ta hen.
